name: terminal
description: Run shell commands and manage foreground and background processes. Sandbox resolves filesystem access, account HOME, workspaces, and confinement. Execution is refused without a verified owner, except in explicit instance-operator direct-host mode.

configSchema.label: Limits
configSchema.hint: Output size and timeout caps for shell commands.

configSchema.label: Output cap
configSchema.hint: How much stdout/stderr a command returns. Past this the middle is dropped and only the beginning and the end come back, with the discarded amount named in the result. Also caps the rolling output buffer kept for background processes. Range 10–500 kB; default 60 kB.

configSchema.label: Command timeout (ms)
configSchema.hint: How long a foreground command may run before it is killed.

configSchema.label: Background processes per session and account
configSchema.hint: How many background processes one session and account may keep running at once; starting another is refused until one is killed. Range 1-64, default 16.
